full_prompt_en: A square decorative painting presents two closely spaced profiles facing one another against a dense field of patterned color. Behind them, narrow bands of deep teal, burgundy, ochre, and charcoal are crossed by fanlike arcs and small tiled marks, so the background feels assembled from many textured pieces rather than opening into a distant landscape. On the left, a pale face turns toward the center. Its strong angular silhouette has a long straight nose, a single dark eye under a golden lid, a small vermilion mouth, and a broad warm ochre shape along the cheek. A richly layered headdress rises to the upper edge with curved blue and orange forms, golden circular accents, and fine radiating strokes. Strips of muted olive, slate blue, russet, and cream descend along the left edge and gather around the neck. On the right, a second pale profile faces outward to the right, close enough that the two heads overlap in the central dark gap. A narrow warm eye sits beneath a blue-gray brow; cool gray, pale turquoise, and ochre facets divide the cheek and nose. Two tall pointed shapes lift above a gold band with round red details, while a terracotta strip runs down the right side of the head. Below the faces, curved teal layers and smaller ochre and rust planes interlock like cut paper. The painting is built from firm dark contours, finely stippled fills, short repeated lines, and flat yet subtly mottled color. Warm frontal illumination keeps the pale profiles bright while the dark red and blue-green recesses preserve depth without a naturalistic cast shadow. The overall composition is tightly interlocked and nearly symmetrical in weight, with luminous cream faces balanced by saturated jewel colors and intricate rhythmic ornament.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形装饰性绘画呈现两张靠得很近、彼此相对的侧脸，背后是密集的纹样色域。深青绿、酒红、赭黄和炭色的窄带与扇形弧线、小块镶嵌般的笔痕交错，使背景仿佛由许多带肌理的碎片拼成，而没有延伸为远景。左侧一张浅色面庞转向中央。强烈的折角轮廓带有笔直的长鼻、金色眼睑下的一只深色眼睛、朱红色小嘴，以及颊侧宽阔的暖赭色块。层层叠叠的华丽头饰升至画面上沿，曲线形蓝橙色块之间点缀金色圆形，并布满细密放射线。暗橄榄、石板蓝、赤褐与奶油色长条沿左边下垂，在颈部周围聚拢。右侧第二张浅色侧脸朝右，两个头部相距很近，在中央深色间隙处互相叠接。蓝灰眉形下有一只细长的暖色眼睛；冷灰、浅青绿和赭色切面分割脸颊与鼻部。两枚高耸尖形从带红色圆点的金色饰带上方升起，赤陶色长带则沿头部右侧垂下。面庞下方，弧形青绿层次与较小的赭色、锈色平面像剪纸一样互相咬合。绘画以坚实的深色轮廓、细密点状填色、重复的短线，以及平涂中微妙斑驳的色彩构成。正面偏暖的光感使浅色侧脸明亮，深红和蓝绿色凹处保留纵深，却没有自然主义的投影。整体构图紧密交错，视觉重量近乎对称，发亮的奶油色面庞与饱和宝石色及复杂的节奏性纹饰相平衡。
style_prompt_en: This decorative painted treatment builds its forms from interlocking angular planes and sweeping arcs. Firm dark contours hold pale cream and cool blue-gray facets apart from deep teal, brick red, ochre, and muted gold. Broad matte color areas carry stippling, tiny repeated strokes, and mosaic-like variations, so the surfaces feel worked rather than digitally smooth. Dense curved bands alternate with slim vertical strips and small circular accents; their repeated intervals create movement within a compact, shallow space. Light concentrates on the largest pale shapes while saturated darker passages recede between them, producing depth through color placement more than cast shadow. The overall effect is intricate, rhythmic, and jewel-toned, with crisp silhouettes softened internally by granular texture.
style_prompt_zh: 这种装饰性绘画以相互咬合的折角平面和大幅弧线建立形体。坚实的深色轮廓把浅奶油色、冷蓝灰色切面与深青绿、砖红、赭色和暗金色区分开来。宽阔的哑光色面覆有点状痕迹、细小重复短线及镶嵌般的色差，使表面呈现手工经营的质感，而非数码般光滑。密集曲带与细窄竖条、小圆形强调交替出现，其重复间隔在紧凑浅空间中制造运动感。光感集中于最大的浅色形体，饱和的暗色区块在其间后退，主要通过色彩位置而非投影建立纵深。整体效果繁复、有节奏，带宝石般的色调；清晰剪影的内部又被颗粒肌理轻轻软化。
theme_en: Two ornamented profiles facing one another
theme_zh: 两张相对的装饰性侧脸
name: Wlad Safronow
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
